b0f2616970477b1882a6.en: A question asks something. It ends with a question mark.
b0f2616970477b1882a6.id: Pertanyaan menanyakan sesuatu. Pertanyaan diakhiri dengan tanda tanya (question mark).

a5d8d81f91446819ec39.en: Many questions start with who, what, where or when.
a5d8d81f91446819ec39.id: Banyak pertanyaan dimulai dengan who, what, where, atau when.

b465efb212762c6fa4a4.en: Some questions start with can, do or is.
b465efb212762c6fa4a4.id: Ada pertanyaan yang dimulai dengan can, do, atau is.

9b9b4475b8381c773e5a.en: An exclamation mark shows a big feeling or a shout.
9b9b4475b8381c773e5a.id: Tanda seru (exclamation mark) menunjukkan perasaan yang kuat atau teriakan.

96a449bab066e6f54685.en: A calm telling sentence ends with a full stop.
96a449bab066e6f54685.id: Kalimat tenang yang memberi tahu sesuatu diakhiri dengan titik.

83c8c285f6472568a13a.en: Do you like fish? asks something and ends with a question mark.
83c8c285f6472568a13a.id: Do you like fish? menanyakan sesuatu dan diakhiri dengan tanda tanya.

22d3cafc68309305c9f3.en: Where is my hat? asks something, so it is a question. It ends with a question mark.
22d3cafc68309305c9f3.id: Where is my hat? menanyakan sesuatu, jadi itu kalimat tanya (question). Kalimat itu diakhiri dengan tanda tanya.

9609de5c3a2ccb8162a7.en: What is your name? asks something. A question ends with a question mark.
9609de5c3a2ccb8162a7.id: What is your name? menanyakan sesuatu. Kalimat tanya (question) diakhiri dengan tanda tanya.

4574335961fd5a859c83.en: Can you swim, Is it raining and Do you like mangoes are questions. The others tell us something.
4574335961fd5a859c83.id: Can you swim, Is it raining, dan Do you like mangoes adalah kalimat tanya (question). Kalimat lainnya memberi tahu kita sesuatu.

7e9adf52920fe8bef69e.en: What is a question word, like who, where and when.
7e9adf52920fe8bef69e.id: What adalah kata tanya, seperti who, where, dan when.

f01dd470c6019da8f20b.en: Wow, a rainbow! shows surprise. It ends with an exclamation mark.
f01dd470c6019da8f20b.id: Wow, a rainbow! menunjukkan rasa terkejut. Kalimat itu diakhiri dengan tanda seru (exclamation mark).

1c0dd180428a7d65dda9.en: Help! is a call out. We use an exclamation mark for shouting and strong feelings.
1c0dd180428a7d65dda9.id: Help! adalah teriakan minta tolong. Kita memakai tanda seru (exclamation mark) untuk teriakan dan perasaan yang kuat.

cbacc5b64332513ffc05.en: Who is at the door?, How old are you? and Can I come too? all ask something.
cbacc5b64332513ffc05.id: Who is at the door?, How old are you?, dan Can I come too? semuanya menanyakan sesuatu.

7866f4e22585a51ee8c9.en: Can moves to the front to make a question: Can you swim? It needs a capital C at the start.
7866f4e22585a51ee8c9.id: Can pindah ke depan untuk membuat kalimat tanya: Can you swim? Kata itu perlu huruf kapital C di awal.

a2e055fb43342a0c9d72.en: Do you like cats? starts with a capital letter and ends with a question mark.
a2e055fb43342a0c9d72.id: Do you like cats? dimulai dengan huruf kapital dan diakhiri dengan tanda tanya.

7eb4cf836054aa4f148c.en: Where is the cat? starts with a capital letter and ends with a question mark.
7eb4cf836054aa4f148c.id: Where is the cat? dimulai dengan huruf kapital dan diakhiri dengan tanda tanya.

37121fd8242e7c00b768.en: A sentence starts with a capital letter.
37121fd8242e7c00b768.id: Kalimat (sentence) dimulai dengan huruf kapital (capital letter).

8f1a38024ddb5561b7a8.en: I am seven tells your age. How old are you? asks about age.
8f1a38024ddb5561b7a8.id: I am seven memberi tahu umurmu. How old are you? menanyakan umur.

2e840d1a1345c7e2fda7.en: Can you see my ball? asks something, so it needs a question mark. I wonder where my ball is tells a thought, so it ends with a full stop.
2e840d1a1345c7e2fda7.id: Can you see my ball? menanyakan sesuatu, jadi perlu tanda tanya. I wonder where my ball is menyampaikan pikiran, jadi diakhiri dengan titik.

691c7a14fb00fcf6abd0.en: Where is my bag? A question ends with a question mark.
691c7a14fb00fcf6abd0.id: Where is my bag? Kalimat tanya diakhiri dengan tanda tanya.

de9f5180903a5a573faa.en: What a big fish! An exclamation ends with an exclamation mark.
de9f5180903a5a573faa.id: What a big fish! Kalimat seru (exclamation) diakhiri dengan tanda seru.

a1c2145f6b7ca1e48099.en: Do you like rice? asks something, so it is a question.
a1c2145f6b7ca1e48099.id: Do you like rice? menanyakan sesuatu, jadi itu kalimat tanya (question).

21c0765c0c583e6af66d.en: Can you hop? is a question, so it needs a question mark.
21c0765c0c583e6af66d.id: Can you hop? adalah kalimat tanya, jadi perlu tanda tanya.

8b596318fa2be1494117.en: Wow, that is huge! shows a strong feeling.
8b596318fa2be1494117.id: Wow, that is huge! menunjukkan perasaan yang kuat.

0220cae1e6bb0ada8914.en: What is your name? asks about a thing.
0220cae1e6bb0ada8914.id: What is your name? menanyakan suatu hal.

56c2bc83d6cad895496c.en: Where do you live? asks about a place.
56c2bc83d6cad895496c.id: Where do you live? menanyakan tempat.

7d161eaab903d74f264a.en: The questions need a question mark. The others tell us something.
7d161eaab903d74f264a.id: Kalimat tanya perlu tanda tanya. Kalimat lainnya memberi tahu kita sesuatu.

d8fdb364e6950ad14c6d.en: Each answer matches the question that comes before it.
d8fdb364e6950ad14c6d.id: Setiap jawaban cocok dengan pertanyaan sebelumnya.

e7de954e48c00f3f9904.en: Do you like milk? is a question.
e7de954e48c00f3f9904.id: Do you like milk? adalah kalimat tanya.

4ca113347e7d44d0846a.en: Where is the dog? is a question.
4ca113347e7d44d0846a.id: Where is the dog? adalah kalimat tanya.

f2562bffab2f0338593f.en: How many eggs are there? asks about a number.
f2562bffab2f0338593f.id: How many eggs are there? menanyakan jumlah.

b27dfb050dfe30fe1b46.en: Is the cat sleeping? and Who made the cake? both ask something.
b27dfb050dfe30fe1b46.id: Is the cat sleeping? dan Who made the cake? sama-sama menanyakan sesuatu.

23b8310c883e3a2925dc.en: Can I come too? asks something, so it ends with a question mark.
23b8310c883e3a2925dc.id: Can I come too? menanyakan sesuatu, jadi diakhiri dengan tanda tanya.

974c60ee8cd42b5200f4.en: A question mark shows that someone is asking something, for example, What is your name?
974c60ee8cd42b5200f4.id: Tanda tanya menunjukkan bahwa seseorang sedang menanyakan sesuatu, misalnya What is your name?

cb4e2bd3b54ea06871a5.en: It is a question, so it ends with a question mark.
cb4e2bd3b54ea06871a5.id: Itu kalimat tanya, jadi diakhiri dengan tanda tanya.

556805b9b275c4c5b626.en: An exclamation mark shows surprise, shouting or excitement, for example, Look out!
556805b9b275c4c5b626.id: Tanda seru (exclamation mark) menunjukkan rasa terkejut, teriakan, atau rasa bersemangat, misalnya Look out!

e46124a3b2ec97cd9d86.en: Only sentences with strong feeling use an exclamation mark. Many sentences end with a full stop.
e46124a3b2ec97cd9d86.id: Hanya kalimat dengan perasaan kuat yang memakai tanda seru (exclamation mark). Banyak kalimat diakhiri dengan titik.

c7eb2a7ed6a754a938d3.en: It asks for an answer, so it is a question and ends with a question mark.
c7eb2a7ed6a754a938d3.id: Kalimat itu meminta jawaban, jadi itu kalimat tanya dan diakhiri dengan tanda tanya.

4f91e7c0cb663b31537a.en: It asks something, so it ends with a question mark.
4f91e7c0cb663b31537a.id: Kalimat itu menanyakan sesuatu, jadi diakhiri dengan tanda tanya.
